text:
## Abstract
The GEO series GSE309890 represents RNA-Seq expression profiling data for Escherichia coli str. K-12 substr. MG1655, featuring six samples. The corresponding BioProject PRJNA1363958 contains six raw sequencing runs (paired-end RNA-Seq data), available on ENA with high-throughput Illumina HiSeq 4000 platform. Each run has over 10 million paired reads. These raw fastq files can be downloaded via provided HTTPS links for assembly or other analyses. This result matters as it confirms that raw reads exist for GSE309890 and are accessible, facilitating genome or transcriptome assembly and further research.

## I. Introduction
Background: GSE309890 is a GEO series study of transcriptional changes in E. coli, studying the effects of the antidepressant sertraline on antibiotic resistance emergence. RNA-Seq data were generated for biological replicates under control and treatment conditions.

Literature Review: No linked PubMed articles are currently available for this dataset, indicating unpublished or recently submitted data.

Knowledge Gap: It was unclear if raw sequencing reads were publicly accessible to perform custom analysis such as assembly.

Objective & Hypothesis: To verify if raw sequencing reads for GSE309890 are available to enable assembly, hypothesizing that raw data do exist based on GEO and SRA metadata.

## II. Materials and Methods
Study Design: Query GEO for GSE309890 metadata, check related BioProject/SRA records for raw reads with download links.

Materials: GEO dataset GSE309890, BioProject PRJNA1363958, ENA SRA run accessions.

Procedures:
1. Queried GEO series GSE309890.
2. Extracted linked BioProject PRJNA1363958.
3. Accessed ENA project method to retrieve sequencing run information, including library strategy, instrument, read counts, and fastq URLs.
4. Verified paired-end RNA-Seq raw data availability with download HTTPS links.

Statistical Analysis: Count of runs and total read count data summarized from ENA metadata.

## III. Results
| Parameter                 | Value                             |
|---------------------------|---------------------------------|
| GEO series accession      | GSE309890                       |
| Organism                  | Escherichia coli K-12 substr MG1655 |
| Number of samples         | 6                               |
| BioProject accession      | PRJNA1363958                    |
| Number of raw runs        | 6                               |
| Library strategy          | RNA-Seq                        |
| Library layout            | Paired-end                      |
| Instrument platform       | Illumina HiSeq 4000             |
| Reads per run             | 10,415,434 to 11,997,182        |
| Raw data download URLs    | Available (HTTPS links provided) |

Findings: Six paired-end RNA-Seq runs are publicly accessible with each run providing over 10 million reads, suitable for raw data assembly workflows.

## IV. Discussion
Interpretation: The availability of raw paired-end RNA-Seq fastq data confirms that users can download and run genome or transcriptome assembly on GSE309890 samples.

Context: The dataset is recent and unpublished, consistent with no linked PubMed records. The raw data presence supports further independent analysis.

Limitations: Collection dates are missing in metadata. The project is RNA-Seq based transcriptomic data; genome assembly from RNA-Seq may require caution as it reflects expressed transcripts rather than full genomic sequences.

Conclusion & Future Directions: Raw data for GSE309890 are accessible for assembly. Future queries could retrieve processed expression matrices or linked variant calls if available.

## References
[1] GEO Series GSE309890. https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE309890  
[2] ENA Study PRJNA1363958 raw reads. https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/portal/api/filereport?accession=PRJNA1363958  

## Acknowledgments
Data providers NCBI GEO and European Nucleotide Archive.
